address: 14870 S Pony Express Road - Bluffdale, UT 84065

reading.body:
DataBank SLC6 publishes 22 MW of IT capacity, making it the largest single published power figure among Utah's mapped data centers, though most facilities in the state disclose no power data at all.

The facility's 88,250 square feet of technical space translates to roughly 2,200 racks at colocation density or 550 racks at AI training density. This constraint matters because AI workloads demand higher power per rack than general hosting, so the same physical power budget supports far fewer machines when optimized for training. The operator publishes no figures for cooling architecture, power redundancy tier, or available versus committed capacity, leaving the actual headroom for new AI workloads opaque.

Among Utah's 21 mapped data center facilities, only three publish megawatt figures at all. Those three together account for 39 MW, so SLC6's ranking by published capacity reflects a narrow slice of disclosed infrastructure rather than a complete picture of the state's installed base. Without visibility into cooling systems, redundancy design, and utilization rates, the power figure alone cannot determine whether this facility has room to add AI compute or is already allocated to other uses.
